target.title: fix: protect uncovered cleanup window in runCodexAppServerAttempt (#99271)
target.body:
## Summary

`runCodexAppServerAttempt` in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.ts` had an uncovered exception window: the single cleanup `finally` started ~160 lines too late, leaving every post-turn-accept resource (notification/request handlers, event projector, steering queue, close handler, abort listener, active-run handle, shared-client lease) unprotected against synchronous throws.

### Change

Move the cleanup try boundary from just before `await completion` to right after turn acceptance (line 2938, +0 behavior change), so the single existing `finally` covers **all** resources acquired in the ~160-line setup window.

- Before: only `attachBackend` + `setActiveEmbeddedRun` were try-protected (partial fix)
- After: user-input bridge, projector, steering queue, handlers, close handler, abort listener, reply backend, active-run handle → all covered by one `finally`

## Test plan

- [x] **Inject test** (`run-attempt.cleanup-inject.test.ts`): patches `replyOperation.attachBackend` to throw synchronously, asserts `detachBackend` (and therefore the full cleanup finally) fires — **passes after fix**
- [x] `run-attempt.dynamic-tools.test.ts` (8 tests) — passed
- [x] `run-attempt.hooks.test.ts` (21 tests) — passed  
- [x] `run-attempt.native-hook-relay.test.ts` (18 tests) — passed
- [x] `attempt-client-cleanup.test.ts` (2 tests) — passed

## Evidence

**L2 — local vitest inject test**

The inject test proves both the pre-fix leak (old version: `detachBackend` not called) and the post-fix full cleanup (expanded try: `detachBackend` called):

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.cleanup-inject.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 E:/Projects/skills/work/openclaw

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

Before: `attachBackend` throwing left handlers, lease, active-run handle leaked.
After: the expanded try boundary means the `finally` runs `notificationCleanup()`, `requestCleanup()`, `closeCleanup?.()`, `releaseSharedClientLeaseAndRetireOneShotClient()`, `detachBackend`, `clearActiveEmbeddedRun` — every cleanup step fires.

## Root cause

The `try` that owns the cleanup `finally` opened at line ~3107 (`await completion`), but all resource acquisition happened between lines ~2938–3096 — a ~160-line uncovered window.

## Expected vs actual behavior

| Scenario | Before | After |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Any synchronous throw in setup window | Handlers/lease/active-run leaked | ✅ Full cleanup fires via finally |
| Normal completion | Unchanged | Unchanged |

## Impact

Prevents notification/request handler leaks on the shared Codex pooled client, shared-client lease leaks, and phantom active-run handles when setup fails. No behavior change for the normal (success) path.

## Proof limitations

No live Codex attempt was executed. Evidence is a vitest inject test on the real function with a mock client — L2 (source-repro + inject test), not L3 (live failing attempt).

## Linked issues

- Fixes #99271
